items.title: In case you missed it: President Eyring dedicates Church’s 225th temple, plus 9 more stories
items.summary: The Church News rounds up its stories from Oct. 18-24, including President Henry B. Eyring dedicating the church's 225th temple in Montpelier, Idaho, Elder Ronald A. Rasband dedicating Nicaragua's first temple, and the latest General Handbook updates.

items.title: No. 2 BYU Suffers Stunning Upset Against UCF as Profane Anti-Mormon Chants Spark Outrage
items.summary: TMSPN reports that sections of UCF's student section repeatedly directed profane anti-Mormon chants at BYU during the Knights' 39-31 double-overtime win, prompting multiple public-address warnings, with several students reportedly escorted out of the stadium. The outlet says the chant reportedly continued during an injury stoppage for a BYU player and that UCF had not issued an official response.
